label: Georgia Group I
size_basis: estimated typical embroidered patch width 3 in (group, squadron and activity patches 3 in); the official digital artwork carries no physical size; height follows the artwork's own aspect
citation: CAPR 39-1 para 10.9 / Attachment 8 define the patch but give no dimensions

artwork.format: svg -> png rendered in a browser (Chrome headless, canvas)
artwork.ground: transparent: the outside of the emblem is the second path of the file (the black surround with the emblem cut out); its coverage gives the alpha, and the colours were divided by that alpha so no black rim is left at the edge (checked at 4x)

provenance: Unit emblem of Georgia Group I (SER-GA-118), vector artwork supplied by the owner, 10 November 2026. Official digital artwork shipped as given: rendered from the supplied vector file (2048 x 2048, 3293 paths, no script, no raster) to a PNG of 1190 x 1204 px; nothing re-drawn, re-coloured or retouched. The one change is the ground: the file had a black square behind the emblem (its second path is the full-square surround with the emblem cut out, over a first path that is the full light blue square which is also the shield's sky); the surround was used as the outside mask, so the square is transparent and the sky stays; then trimmed to its alpha bounding box.
notes: Official digital artwork as given, not a redraw: no thread texture added, nothing re-drawn or re-coloured. The source SVG (1.9 MB) is kept in assets/refs/unit-emblems-supplied/ and is too heavy for the page, so the page draws the PNG.
